Per the On-Call and Incident Process (doc `oncall-incident-process`, §6, lines 55–59), SEV2 covers "degraded service with a workaround, **a delay in data of more than 30 minutes**, or a single customer fully affected." Requirements for SEV2:
- **Ack within 15 minutes** (PagerLine auto-escalates to the secondary at 5 minutes, then the engineering manager 10 minutes after that).
- Assign an incident commander; one person may hold both commander and communications roles.
- Open `#inc-YYYYMMDD-short-name` (e.g. `#inc-20250714-ingest-lag`).

- Mitigate before root-causing; Customer Success liaison handles customer contact.
